description.en: Canada, a sovereign North American nation stretching from the Atlantic to the Pacific and northward into the Arctic Ocean, is the world's second-largest country by total area. Renowned for its highly progressive social policies, vast wilderness, dual-language heritage, exceptional quality of life, and economic stability, Canada stands as a pinnacle of global multiculturalism and democratic values.
description.zh: 加拿大(Canada)是一個主權獨立的北美洲(North America)國家，國土橫跨大西洋(Atlantic Ocean)至太平洋(Pacific Ocean)，向北延伸至北冰洋(Arctic Ocean)，是世界上面積第二大的國家。加拿大(Canada)以其高度前瞻的社會政策、廣袤無垠的自然荒野、雙語文化遺產、卓越的生活品質以及穩健的經濟發展而聞名於世，是全球多元文化主義(Multiculturalism)與民主價值的最高典範。

seoText.en: Explore essential quick facts about Canada — including detailed population data, total land area, capital city Ottawa, and a comprehensive geographic overview. Learn about Niagara Falls, the iconic maple syrup heritage, the wilderness of the Rocky Mountains, pioneering green energy policies, and the progressive Canadian multicultural lifestyle.
seoText.zh: 快速了解加拿大(Canada)的完整基本資料：包括最新的人口數據、土地面積、首都渥太華(Ottawa)與深度的國家概述。帶您一探舉世聞名的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls)、指標性的楓糖漿(Maple Syrup)文化遺產、壯麗的洛磯山脈(Rocky Mountains)自然荒野、領先全球的綠色清潔能源政策，以及加拿大(Canada)引以為傲的多元文化包容生活哲學。

list: A massive sovereign North American nation governed as a federal parliamentary constitutional monarchy stretching from coast to coast
A highly progressive and globally celebrated dual-language federation officially recognizing both the English and French languages
An economic and technological powerhouse characterized by an advanced social welfare system providing exceptional public healthcare
Consistently ranked at the absolute pinnacle of global safety, human development indexes, and multicultural societal integration
en.text:
Stretching across magnificent landscapes from the violent waves of the Atlantic Ocean to the deep waters of the Pacific Ocean, Canada(Canada) represents the absolute peak of a highly progressive, modern North American democratic society. As a land originally shaped by Indigenous Peoples(Indigenous Peoples) and later enriched by French and British explorers, the nation beautifully balances its profound historical heritage with a sleek, forward-thinking, and minimalist contemporary global outlook.

Today, Canada(Canada) stands proud as an exceptionally advanced, highly prosperous welfare state, leading the international community in ecological sustainability, human rights protections, and bicycle-friendly urban infrastructure. From the historic cobblestone streets of 魁北克市(Quebec City) to the high-tech financial districts of 多倫多(Toronto), the nation fosters an atmosphere of deep mutual respect and social cohesion, proving that diverse cultures can thrive together under one maple leaf flag.

list: 一個實施聯邦議會君主立憲制的主權獨立北美洲(North America)大國，國土橫跨大西洋(Atlantic Ocean)與太平洋(Pacific Ocean)
全球公認高度進步的雙語聯邦國家，在法律與社會體制上正式承認英語(English)與法語(French)的雙官方語言地位
實力雄厚的經濟與科技強國，以高度發達的社會福利制度、全面的全民醫療保健與優質的公共教育體系享譽全球
在歷年全球幸福指數、人類發展指數(Human Development Index)以及多元文化社會融合度報告中皆常年名列前茅
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)是一座幅員遼闊、風光旖旎的北美洲(North America)國家，南面與美國(United States)接壤，形成世界上最長的不設防國界。國土由十個省與三個地區共同組成，自古以來便是第一民族(First Nations)、因紐特人(Inuit)與梅蒂人(Métis)等原住民的家園，隨後在歷史洪流中迎來了法國與英國的開拓者，共同交織出如今深厚且獨特的雙語文化底蘊。

現今的加拿大(Canada)在國際上扮演著舉足輕重的進步角色，以首都渥太華(Ottawa)為政治核心，不僅在科技創新與環境保護上走在世界前列，更透過其健全的移民政策，將多元文化主義(Multiculturalism)確立為國家發展的核心資產。無論是繁華現代的西岸門戶溫哥華(Vancouver)，還是充滿歐洲風情的東岸都市蒙特婁(Montreal)，都完美體現了這座國家兼顧經濟繁榮、社會公義與自然生態永續發展的卓越成就。

list: Spans six dynamic time zones encompassing massive low rolling plains, pristine boreal forests, and tundra ecosystems
Contains more than half of the entire world's natural freshwater lakes within its secure territorial borders
Features the spectacular, snow-capped Rocky Mountains framing the scenic western continental landscapes
Possesses the longest winding maritime coastline of any sovereign nation on Earth, measuring over two hundred thousand kilometers
en.text:
Covering an astonishing area of approximately 9,984,670 square kilometers, Canada(Canada) possesses a geography that is legendary for its sheer scale, diversity, and natural beauty. The terrain transitions dramatically from the rugged Atlantic coastline and the ancient Laurentian Shield(Laurentian Shield) to the endless agricultural wheat fields of the Canadian Prairies(Canadian Prairies), before rising abruptly into the majestic peaks of the 洛磯山脈(Rocky Mountains).

The vast Arctic Archipelago(Arctic Archipelago) dominates the northern expanses, freezing into a pristine wilderness of tundra, while the fertile Great Lakes(Great Lakes) and 聖勞倫斯河(St. Lawrence River) basin in the east serve as the historic, economic, and demographic heartland of the entire country, housing the majority of the population and supporting major industrial clusters.

list: 地理結構極其巨大，橫跨六個時區，境內涵蓋平原、寒帶針葉林(Boreal Forest)與北極凍原等豐富的生態系統
國土境內坐擁世界上數量最多且最密集的天然淡水湖泊，其淡水總儲量位居全球國家之冠
西部由綿延壯麗的洛磯山脈(Rocky Mountains)縱貫，擁有無數未受污染的國家公園與冰河地形景觀
擁有世界上最長且極其曲折的海洋海岸線，總長度超過二十萬公里，與海洋生態及全球海事航運密不可分
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的地形極具震撼力，東臨大西洋(Atlantic Ocean)，西瀕太平洋(Pacific Ocean)，北達北冰洋(Arctic Ocean)，其獨特的地理構造賦予了它無與倫比的天然資源。中部的加拿大地盾(Canadian Shield)是一片古老的岩石區，蘊藏著極為豐富的礦產與森林資源；而南部的普雷里平原(Prairie Provinces)則是肥沃的農業溫床，被譽為加拿大的糧倉。

水系網絡是加拿大地理的另一大特色，除了與美國共管的五大湖(Great Lakes)外，境內更散落著如大熊湖(Great Bear Lake)與大奴湖(Great Slave Lake)等巨型湖泊。這種水文優勢不僅提供了豐沛的民生與工業用水，更為國家發展大規模清潔水力發電(Hydroelectricity)奠定了得天獨厚的物理基礎。

list: Ranges from severe subarctic and arctic freezing conditions to pleasant temperate oceanic climates
Experiences intensely snowy, cold, and dramatic winter months with short northern daylight hours
Enjoys beautifully warm, refreshing, and bright summer seasons perfect for massive outdoor recreational tourism
Receives varying regional precipitation levels driving rich agricultural outputs and deep winter snowpacks
en.text:
Given its massive continental scale, Canada(Canada) features a highly varied climate that ranges from the polar freezes of the far north to the gentle, mild maritime weather of British Columbia(British Columbia). Winters in the interior provinces can be exceptionally severe, characterized by deep snow blankets, high freezing winds, and temperatures that frequently plunge far below zero, which has deeply shaped the resilient national character.

Conversely, summers are delightfully vibrant and warm across the southern regions, where temperature ranges encourage extensive farming, winery operations, and bustling urban festivals. The coastal regions, particularly near 溫哥華(Vancouver), remain temperate and humid year-round, receiving soft Pacific rains rather than heavy snowstorms, creating a microclimate heavily favored by retirees and outdoor enthusiasts.

list: 氣候類型極其多樣，從北部嚴寒的極地與副極地氣候，到西海岸溫和宜人的溫帶海洋性氣候皆有分布
多數內陸區域冬季氣候漫長、寒冷且降雪量極大，日照時間顯著縮短，形成舉世聞名的冰雪冬景
夏季氣候普遍溫暖爽朗、陽光充沛，是一年之中舉辦大型文藝節慶與進行戶外自然探險的黃金季節
各地降水與降雪量受地理位置影響而有顯著差異，豐富的冬季積雪為北國提供了頂級的冬季運動場地
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的氣候特徵深受其緯度與洋流的調節影響。在中部與東部省分，如安大略省(Ontario)與魁北克省(Quebec)，四季分明且變化劇烈，春季的融雪催生了楓糖的採收，而秋季滿山遍野的紅楓更是震撼人心的自然奇觀。

北部的育空(Yukon)、西北地區(Northwest Territories)與努納武特(Nunavut)則長年處於極寒狀態，展現出北極圈特有的極光與永晝永夜現象。這種嚴酷卻也壯麗的氣候條件，不僅孕育了當地居民獨特的生活智慧，也讓加拿大人在節能建築技術、冬季基礎設施維護以及耐寒農業科技的研發上，位居全球領先地位。

list: Home to a dynamic and steadily expanding population of approximately forty-one million diverse residents
Displays a highly unique distribution with most citizens clustered within one hundred miles of the American border
Features major demographic concentrations within the sprawling Greater Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver hubs
Maintains a world-leading, highly strategic selective immigration system attracting global talent seamlessly
en.text:
Canada(Canada) currently houses a population of approximately 41 million people, displaying an incredibly unique demographic blueprint marked by vast empty spaces and highly dense, cosmopolitan urban centers. Due to the historical development of trade networks and the severe northern climate, more than eighty percent of the population lives in close proximity to the southern border shared with the 美國(United States).

The country stands out globally for its remarkably high percentage of foreign-born residents, a direct result of decades of proactive, points-based immigration policies designed to support economic expansion and balance the low birth rates and aging society common across North America. This influx of global talent ensures that cities like 多倫多(Toronto) remain incredibly youthful, innovative, and culturally vibrant.

list: 全國常住總人口已突破四千一百萬人，呈現健康、穩定增長且社會結構高度包容的良性特徵
人口地理分布呈現極其特殊的「南密北疏」格局，高達八成以上的居民居住在鄰近美國邊境的狹長地帶
人口高度集中於三大都會區：多倫多(Toronto)、蒙特婁(Montreal)與溫哥華(Vancouver)，城鄉發展兼顧秩序
擁有全球最完善且具戰略眼光的技術移民評分制度，源源不絕地吸引全球高素質人才移居
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的人口結構是全球多元文化主義(Multiculturalism)的縮影。這個國家不僅由英語系與法語系兩大歷史族群奠定基礎，更張開雙臂歡迎來自亞洲、歐洲、非洲與中南美洲的移民，共同建構出一個不強調強迫同化、而是鼓勵保留自身文化傳統的「馬賽克社會(Mosaic Society)」。

政府長期投入大量資源於新移民的語言培訓、就業輔導與社群融入，這使得加拿大得以有效應對歐美國家普遍面臨的少子化與勞動力老齡化挑戰。同時，原住民社群的權益保障與文化復興在近年也受到國家的高度重視，成為人口政策與社會和解進程中不可或缺的重要篇章。

list: Operates a highly advanced, prosperous, and diversified social market economy with immense global reach
Stands as an absolute global titan in energy production, mineral mining, and high-value natural resources
Possesses a world-class automotive, aerospace, and advanced artificial intelligence technology sector
Maintains deep, integrated trade ties across North America via the comprehensive USMCA trade agreement
en.text:
As a prominent member of the 七大工業國集團(G7), Canada(Canada) operates a highly sophisticated, multi-billion-dollar modern economy that blends market-driven efficiency with strong public sector foundations. The nation is an absolute superpower when it comes to natural resources, possessing the world's third-largest proven oil reserves in the 阿爾伯塔省(Alberta) oil sands, alongside staggering exports of natural gas, timber, gold, and uranium.

However, modern Canada is far more than a resource supplier; its manufacturing and service sectors are exceptionally advanced. Southern Ontario functions as a critical manufacturing hub for global automotive giants, while cities like 蒙特婁(Montreal) lead the world in aerospace engineering, and Toronto and Vancouver have transformed into massive international centers for software development, financial services, and clean technology.

list: 身為七大工業國集團(G7)核心成員，擁有高度發達、富裕且產業多元化的現代市場經濟體
全球公認的資源超級大國，在原油儲量、天然氣外銷、林業綠色開採與稀有金屬礦業上居世界領先地位
坐擁世界頂尖的航太工程、汽車製造供應鏈，以及近年蓬勃發展的尖端人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence)研發聚落
透過美墨加協定(USMCA)與美國及墨西哥建立了極其深厚的北美自由貿易與供應鏈一體化網絡
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的經濟實力奠基於其豐富的天然財富與高度創新的人力資本。在傳統產業方面，普雷里平原的農業外銷養活了全球數百萬人口，而其發達的金融體系更以穩健、高抗風險能力著稱，在歷次全球金融危機中皆表現出極高的穩定性。

近年來，加拿大積極推動產業綠色轉型，政府與企業攜手投入數十億資金研發碳捕集與封存(Carbon Capture and Storage)技術、氫能(Hydrogen Energy)以及次世代電動車(EV)電池供應鏈。搭配其在多倫多(Toronto)與蒙特婁(Montreal)建立的全球人工智慧科研重鎮，加拿大正成功將自己定位為未來低碳知識經濟的領頭羊。

list: Governed as a stable federal parliamentary democracy underneath a dignified constitutional monarchy system
Recognizes the reigning British monarch as the official ceremonial head of state represented by a Governor General
Features a highly active multiparty political system that balances regional interests and federal stability
Operates with a strictly independent judiciary protecting citizens via the Charter of Rights and Freedoms
en.text:
Canada's political architecture is built upon the British Westminster parliamentary model, beautifully adapted to govern a massive, ethnically diverse federal nation. Executive power is held by the Prime Minister(Prime Minister), who serves as the head of government and leads the political party capable of securing the confidence of the elected 眾議院(House of Commons).

The legislative branch is bicameral, combining the democratically elected lower house with an appointed 參議院(Senate) designed to provide regional representation. Political power continuously flows between major political parties, establishing a robust legacy of governance that prioritizes social compromise, institutional transparency, and a deep, unshakeable respect for the rule of law and human liberties.

list: 政治體制為成熟、穩定的聯邦議會制民主政體，並在憲政架構下實行君主立憲制
英國君主為國家名義上的虛位元首，實務上由其任命的加拿大總督(Governor General)代表行使國家禮儀職權
實施成熟的多黨制政黨政治，透過國會辯論與協商機制，有效平衡各省分權與聯邦政府的整體利益
擁有完全獨立的司法體系，並透過權利與自由憲章(Charter of Rights and Freedoms)對公民權利提供最高法律保障
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的政治運作以權力分立與聯邦主義(Federalism)為核心原則。聯邦政府負責國防、外交、國際貿易與金融貨幣等全國性事務；而十個省政府則擁有極大的自治權，獨立管轄醫療保健、公共教育、自然資源開發以及地方民事法律。

這種政治設計雖然伴隨著長期的聯邦與地方財政談判，但也賦予了如魁北克省(Quebec)等特定區域保留其法語文化與獨特民法體系的空間。整座國家的政治文化強調溫和、包容與社會共識，在重大國際人權事務與環境保護議題上，加拿大政府始終保持著高度一致的進步立場，是全球多邊主義(Multilateralism)的堅定捍衛者。

list: Champions multiculturalism as a core federal legislative policy, encouraging diverse heritage cultural retention
Provides a world-renowned, publicly funded universal healthcare system accessible to all legal citizens
Boasts one of the highest percentages of tertiary education degree holders among all major global economies
Emphasizes an exceptional work-life balance that strongly promotes family welfare and outdoor recreation
en.text:
Danish levels of social trust are mirrored perfectly within Canadian society, which is intentionally designed as a vibrant multicultural mosaic rather than a cultural melting pot. This unique social philosophy, officially supported by the 1971 多元文化主義政策(Multiculturalism Policy), encourages citizens of all ethnic backgrounds to maintain, honor, and share their unique cultural heritage openly.

The pillar of daily social security is the publicly funded Medicare(Medicare) healthcare system, which guarantees that medical treatment is based on human need rather than financial wealth. Backed by world-class public schools and incredibly safe urban neighborhoods, the society fosters a progressive atmosphere where gender equality, LGBTQ+ rights, and freedom of expression are deeply woven into the national identity.

list: 全球首個將多元文化主義(Multiculturalism)確立為國家基本法案的聯邦，鼓勵各族群保留自身文化根源
實行全民公共醫療保健制度(Medicare)，為所有合法的加拿大居民提供由政府財政全面資助的優質醫療服務
國民受教育程度極高，高等教育學位持有率在經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)國家中常年高居世界前列
倡導極致的「工作與生活平衡(Work-Life Balance)」，社會風氣極度重視家庭陪伴、社區和諧與親近自然
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)社會的穩定與和諧，源自於其強大的社會福利安全網與對人權的極致尊重。這裡的公共教育體系不分貧富，致力於提供均等的機會，這使得加拿大成為全球社會流動性(Social Mobility)最高的國家之一。

不論是原住民的歷史和解、性別平權，還是對各國難民的人道主義接納，加拿大社會普遍展現出令人讚嘆的同理心與包容力。居民在日常生活中高度遵守法律、注重社區互助，並將對大自然的熱愛融入骨子裡，每逢週末假期，攜家帶眷前往郊外露營、滑雪或划皮艇，早已成為加拿大式幸福生活的標準寫照。

list: Combines deep Indigenous histories with rich French, British, and modern global immigrant traditions
Fosters a world-class artistic, cinematic, and musical community with massive global pop culture influence
Maintains an absolute national obsession with ice hockey, which serves as a vital unifying social force
Celebrates the iconic maple leaf emblem and a profound, historic relationship with nature conservation
en.text:
Canadian cultural identity is a fascinating, dynamic tapestry woven from the ancient strands of First Nations, Inuit, and Métis storytellers, the early foundational language cultures of France and Great Britain, and the modern contributions of millions of immigrants. In the artistic realm, Canada(Canada) has produced globally celebrated cultural icons ranging from the legendary paintings of the 七人畫派(Group of Seven) to world-famous modern musical artists and visionary filmmakers who dominate Hollywood.

Yet, nothing unifies the country quite like the shared passion for 冰球(Ice Hockey). Played on backyard frozen rinks and in massive sold-out arenas from coast to coast, hockey is far more than a recreational sport—它是一種世世代代傳承的文化宗教，完美體現了加拿大人在面對嚴酷自然時所展現的堅韌精神與團隊凝聚力。

list: 文化底蘊深厚，由古老原住民文化、法國與英國的雙語傳統，以及近代全球移民的多元習俗交織而成
孕育出無數世界級的文學家、電影導演與流行音樂巨星，在全球當代流行文化中擁有強大的話語權與影響力
將冰球(Ice Hockey)視為至高無上的「國球」，這項運動不僅是全民娛樂，更是凝聚國家認同的強大精神紐帶
以楓葉(Maple Leaf)與楓糖文化為國家象徵，並將深刻的生態保育觀念完美融入大眾的日常文藝與生活方式中
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的文化展現出寬廣的國際視野與深刻的人文關懷。從 Margaret Atwood 的經典文學作品，到每年吸引無數好萊塢巨星前來的多倫多國際電影節(TIFF)，加拿大在文藝創作上始終保持著旺盛的生命力。同時，原住民的傳統雕刻、圖騰柱藝術以及對土地的敬畏哲學，近年來越發受到主流文化的推崇與融合。

在飲食方面，享譽世界的楓糖漿(Maple Syrup)不僅是餐桌上的美味，更是一種代表春天到來的文化儀式；而發源於魁北克的肉汁起司薯條(Poutine)，則以其樸實濃郁的風味征服了全球老饕的味蕾。這種將傳統與現代、本土與國際完美融合的文化特質，正是加拿大最迷人之處。

list: Balancing aggressive greenhouse gas emission cuts alongside profitable oil and gas resource extraction
Addressing critical real estate affordability crises across major metropolitan areas like Vancouver and Toronto
Accelerating the comprehensive Truth and Reconciliation process to support Indigenous systemic improvements
Adapting extensive social infrastructure to match historically high levels of annual economic immigration
en.text:
Despite its exceptional quality of life, Canada(Canada) actively confronts a complex set of modern socioeconomic and structural challenges. Environmental policy remains a persistent political battleground, as the federal government strives to achieve ambitious 碳中和(Carbon Neutrality) goals while managing the economic interests of resource-dependent provinces like Alberta, creating a delicate balancing act between green progress and traditional industrial employment.

Furthermore, the massive influx of international capital and rapid population growth have fueled a severe housing affordability crisis in urban centers, pricing out many younger Canadians. Simultaneously, the country is deeply engaged in the ongoing 真相與和解(Truth and Reconciliation) process, seeking to dismantle decades of systemic discrimination and historical trauma experienced by Indigenous communities through concrete legislative reforms and funding.

list: 面臨嚴峻的環保兩難：如何在落實激進的減碳目標同時，合理維護利潤豐厚之傳統石油與天然氣產業的經濟產值
首都圈及一線都會區（如溫哥華與多倫多）的房地產價格連年暴漲，導致年輕世代面臨嚴重的住房負擔能力危機
積極推進真相與和解(Truth and Reconciliation)進程，致力消除歷史體制缺陷並全面保障原住民社群的實質權益
在移民人口大幅增加的背景下，如何同步升級醫療、大眾運輸與公共教育等基礎設施，以維持原有的高品質服務
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)在邁向更進步社會的道路上，正積極面對並解決各項結構性難題。在經濟層面，全球供應鏈的波動與通貨膨脹，對高度依賴進出口的加拿大市場帶來了不小的壓力；而都市房價的居高不下，也促使政府開始重新檢視房地產稅制與社會住宅的興建規模。

在社會融合方面，隨著每年引進的技術移民與國際留學生數量創下歷史新高，如何在短時間內擴建醫療與住房基礎設施，並防範潛在的社會摩擦，成為了聯邦政壇辯論的焦點。然而，加拿大憑藉其成熟的民主機制與理性思辨的社會風氣，始終致力於透過跨黨派的政策協商，在挑戰中尋求兼顧社會公義與經濟永續的務實解方。

list: Niagara Falls — A breathtakingly massive and world-famous natural waterfall marvel located on the Ontario border
Banff National Park — A stunning jewel in the Canadian Rockies renowned for turquoise glacial alpine lakes
CN Tower — An iconic architectural engineering marvel dominating the modern skyline of downtown Toronto
Old Montreal — A beautifully preserved historic district radiating historic French colonial charm and cobblestones
en.text:
Canada's vast landscapes are dotted with incredible natural wonders and architectural marvels that attract millions of international travelers annually. In the heart of Ontario, the thundering cascade of 尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls) showcases the absolute raw power of nature, while the serene, emerald waters of Lake Louise in 班夫國家公園(Banff National Park) offer an unforgettable encounter with the majestic, wild heart of the western alpine ranges.

For those drawn to urban adventure, 多倫多(Toronto) offers the towering view from the 西恩塔(CN Tower), once the world's tallest free-standing structure. Meanwhile, wandering through the centuries-old plazas of Old Montreal(Old Montreal) allows visitors to step back in time, enjoying world-class French cuisine, artisan boutiques, and historic street performances that reflect Canada's profound European roots.

list: 尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls) —— 位於安大略省(Ontario)邊境，是世界上流量最大、最震撼人心的天然瀑布奇景之一
班夫國家公園(Banff National Park) —— 洛磯山脈(Rocky Mountains)中的璀璨明珠，以夢幻的土耳其藍冰河湖泊聞名
西恩塔(CN Tower) —— 傲然屹立於多倫多(Toronto)市中心的指標性現代建築工程奇蹟，曾長期奪得全球最高建築桂冠
老蒙特婁(Old Montreal) —— 歷史悠久且保存極其完好的古老街區，處處散發著法式殖民時期的古典浪漫情調與歷史美感
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的觀光資源豐富得令人讚嘆，大自然的鬼斧神工與人類的建築智慧在這裡完美交融。在西岸，除了名震全球的班夫國家公園外，相鄰的賈斯珀國家公園(Jasper National Park)更擁有北極圈外最大的冰原遺跡，提供遊客近距離觸摸萬年冰河的震撼體驗；而溫哥華的卡皮拉諾吊橋(Capilano Suspension Bridge)則讓人在漫步樹冠之餘，領略溫帶雨林的蒼翠與幽靜。

轉向東部的人文景觀，魁北克古城(Old Quebec)是北美洲唯一保留了古老城牆的城市，其歷史城區已被聯合國教科文組織(UNESCO)列為世界文化遺產，宛如童話故事般的芳堤娜城堡飯店(Fairmont Le Château Frontenac)更是全球上鏡率最高的飯店。這些極具代表性的地標，不僅吸引了全球旅人的目光，更深深承載著加拿大歷史演進的豐富軌跡。

list: A highly respected mid-tier diplomatic power driving critical multilateral cooperative alliances globally
A deeply committed, core founding member state of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization security alliance
An active member of the United Nations, G7, G20, and the multi-nation Commonwealth of Nations
A generous global donor passionately funding international humanitarian aid, human rights, and refugee protection
en.text:
On the global stage, Canada(Canada) has earned an exceptional reputation as a compassionate, constructive middle power that consistently advocates for peace, multilateral diplomacy, and the international rule of law. As a vital founding member of both the 聯合國(United Nations) and NATO(NATO), the nation has historically pioneered the very concept of modern international peacekeeping, deploying thousands of personnel to stabilize global conflict zones.

Canada leverages its active membership within elite global forums like the G7 and G20 to aggressively champion international environmental compacts, free trade initiatives, and gender equality. The country's generous international development assistance programs target poverty reduction, maternal health, and democratic governance support across developing nations, cementing its status as a trusted, essential global partner for progressive international development.

list: 在國際外交舞台上深受敬重的「中等強國(Middle Power)」，是推動多邊主義與區域和平合作的核心力量
北大西洋公約組織(NATO)的創始成員國之一，在跨大西洋集體安全與防務體系中扮演著極其關鍵的戰略支柱角色
聯合國(United Nations)、七大工業國(G7)、二十大工業國(G20)以及大英國協(Commonwealth of Nations)的極活躍成員
全球重要的人道主義援助捐助國，長期投入巨額資金支持國際難民庇護、全球人權倡議與性別平等運動
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)的外交哲學向來以溫和、務實與維護國際公義為核心。在冷戰時期，加拿大前首相、諾貝爾和平獎得主 Lester B. Pearson 便提出了現代聯合國維和部隊(Peacekeeping)的概念，這奠定了加拿大長年作為「世界和平維護者」的崇高國際形象。不論是在推動禁止地雷的渥太華條約(Ottawa Treaty)，還是國際刑事法院(ICC)的建立上，加拿大都發揮了無可替代的催化劑作用。

此外，加拿大與鄰國美國(United States)維持著全方位、深層次的戰略合作夥伴關係，雙方在北美空防司令部(NORAD)的架構下共同捍衛大陸安全。同時，加拿大也積極拓展與亞太地區及歐洲盟友的經貿外交關係，透過簽署跨太平洋夥伴全面進步協定(CPTPP)等高標準自由貿易協定，持續擴大其在全球多邊經貿體系中的關鍵影響力。

list: Maintains highly robust, dynamically expanding unofficial commercial and economic trade relations with Taiwan
Forges deep corporate and environmental partnerships in high-tech semiconductor supply chain development
Shares extensive, valuable bilateral exchanges regarding clean energy transformation and carbon reduction tech
Nurtures massive educational, academic research, and tourism connections supported by vibrant diaspora communities
en.text:
While maintaining a formal One-China Policy, Canada(Canada) and 台灣(Taiwan) share an incredibly successful, robust, and dynamic unofficial partnership built on a bedrock of shared democratic values, human rights, and open market economics. Bilateral trade has reached historic highs, driven by deep cooperation in high-technology sectors, including semiconductor manufacturing chains, advanced telecommunications, and aerospace hardware components.

The relationship was significantly upgraded via the signing of a comprehensive 投資促進及保障協議(FIPA) in late 2023, providing a secure, transparent legal framework for mutual corporate investments. Furthermore, the two nations engage in highly productive cultural and academic knowledge exchanges, particularly focused on Indigenous languages revitalization and circular green economic research, closely supported by energetic Taiwanese-Canadian diaspora communities across British Columbia and Ontario.

list: 雙邊實質經貿往來極其密切，在非官方架構下建立了全面性、穩健成長的經貿與科技戰略夥伴關係
在尖端半導體供應鏈、前瞻資通訊科技、智慧製造與航太工業領域維持著高頻率且深度的企業技術合作
在循環經濟淨零碳排轉型、綠色清潔能源技術研發以及永續農業等低碳產業方面，雙邊官學界交流日益頻繁
兩國大專院校間的學術科研合作網絡發展成熟，搭配蓬勃的觀光互訪，讓兩國人民建立起極深厚的情誼
zh.text:
加拿大(Canada)與台灣(Taiwan)雖然沒有正式建交，但雙方基於自由、民主與法治等共同價值觀，在各領域的實質合作皆取得了突破性進展。特別是在經貿投資領域，兩國於 2023 年底正式簽署了投資促進及保障協議(FIPA)，這為雙邊企業鋪設了更加安全、透明且具法律保障的投資渠道，極大地激發了雙邊在生技醫療與綠能工程上的共同研發潛力。

此外，加拿大近年發布的印太戰略(Indo-Pacific Strategy)中，明確將台灣定位為其在印太地區重要且不可或缺的經濟與科技合作夥伴，並多次在國際場合公開支持台灣有意義地參與世界衛生組織(WHO)等國際多邊體系。在民間交流方面，廣大的台灣裔加拿大移民社群在當地社會表現優異，成為促成兩國在環境科學、原住民文化保存以及高等教育雙向合作上最堅實、最具活力的文化橋樑。

list: Consistently praised as one of the most inclusive and safe sovereign nations across the modern world
An undisputed international frontrunner in sustainable forestry management and hydro-energy innovations
Boasts a highly liveable urban framework seamlessly integrating vast national parks and clean transit systems
Perfectly illustrates the progressive middle-power socio-economic governance blueprint for global prosperity
各項人類發展與幸福指標無懈可擊，常年被聯合國(United Nations)評為全球最安全、最宜居、最具社會包容力的國度
引領全球綠色資源革命，在永續林業開採、大規模水力發電與尖端碳捕集技術領域擁有無可撼動的世界領導地位
成功將廣袤宏偉的自然保護區與高度發達的現代化城市規劃完美融合，打造出兼顧低碳、健康與生態友善的宜居城鎮典範
完美體現了現代進步國家「高教育、強福利、重多元、崇法治」的治理精髓，為人類文明社會的永續繁榮提供完美藍圖

quickFacts.value: 加拿大元(Canadian Dollar / CAD，由加拿大銀行發行，簡稱加幣，在國際金融與外匯儲備市場中占有極其重要的核心地位)

value.zh: 英語與法語(English and French，屬於雙官方語言制度，在聯邦法院、國會及所有聯邦公共服務機構中均享有完全平等的法律地位)

text.en: The Maple Leaf — The world-famous national symbol officially adopted on the Canadian flag in 1965, beautifully representing unity, historical heritage, and an enduring deep respect for the breathtaking natural environment
text.zh: 楓葉國旗(The Maple Leaf) —— 於1965年正式啟用的加拿大(Canada)指標性國旗象徵，紅白相間的設計完美代表了國家的團結、雙語歷史遺產，以及加拿大人對廣袤壯麗自然生態根深蒂固的熱愛與敬畏

text.en: Winter Wonderland Culture — A majestic winter tradition defined by a passionate global dominance in winter Olympic sports, world-class expansive ski resorts, and historically celebrated annual frozen winter festivals
text.zh: 北國冰雪冬景文化(Winter Wonderland) —— 加拿大(Canada)擁有得天獨厚的冬季資源，國民在冬季奧運的冰雪項目上展現出無可撼動的全球統治力，境內更坐擁惠斯勒(Whistler)等世界級滑雪勝地

text.en: Maple Syrup Production — An iconic culinary export where Canada, predominantly driven by the historic province of Quebec, proudly supplies over seventy percent of the entire planet's pure organic sweet maple syrup
text.zh: 世界楓糖漿王國(Maple Syrup) —— 加拿大(Canada)是全球最主要的純天然楓糖漿生產國，主要產地集中在歷史悠久的魁北克省(Quebec)，其供應量占全球總市佔率七成以上，是無可替代的頂級美食文化遺產

text.en: National Ice Hockey Obsession — The official Canadian national winter sport acting as a powerful social glue, bringing families together on outdoor natural frozen ponds and in filled major league stadiums year after year
text.zh: 全民冰球狂熱(Ice Hockey) —— 加拿大(Canada)法定官方冬季運動，這項充滿速度與激情的競賽早已化身為強大的社會凝聚劑，不論是社區結冰池塘還是職業聯賽場地，冰球都是國家精神的最高體現

text.en: Cultural Mosaic Ideology — A pioneering federal legislative approach to social diversity that formally celebrates, funds, and protects the unique cultural roots of every immigrant group instead of melting them away
text.zh: 多元文化馬賽克哲學(Cultural Mosaic) —— 加拿大(Canada)享譽全球的社會治理模式，法律明文鼓勵、資助並保護各個移民群體保留其獨特的文化根源與宗教習俗，成功打造出多元共榮的和諧進步社會
